name: match_invoice
title: Match invoice
description: Three-way match of a recorded invoice: is there a released order with this supplier for this item, have the goods been received, is the quantity billed no more than received, and is the price within tolerance (2% unless you give less; the policy cap is 5%)? Sets the invoice to MATCHED when all agree. result is matched, price_variance, quantity_variance, no_receipt, no_order, supplier_mismatch, item_mismatch or order_not_released.

ok.description: true when it worked; false comes with error and next_step

matched.description: true when it can be posted

policy.on_lost_write_reply: never resent blindly: look the document up (by the supplier's number or its id) and return it
policy.on_busy_before_write: ok=false with next_step; nothing was saved, so the same call is safe to repeat
